sample_size_method: pooled two-proportion normal approximation; one-sided alpha=.05

effect_size_contract.freeze_rule: The 5 percentage-point / 2.0x improvement is operationally useful and fixed before capture; no post-freeze tuning.

sample_size.assessment_360_per_arm: insufficient for the 90% sensitivity target; retained only as historical preliminary recommendation

randomization.method: seeded deterministic Fisher-Yates shuffle of pre-matched 1:1 pairs

treatment_query_generation_rule: Use only pre-V4 S2/V3 compact informational forms: what is X; how does X work; what causes X; how does X operate. X is a pre-authored informational topic. Lowercase/trim/Unicode NFC; include exactly one form; exclude labels, result features, named providers, temporal modifiers, navigational/commercial intent, and manual edits.
control_query_generation_rule: For the same pre-authored topic and in the same deterministic matched-pair order, use a non-compact informational paraphrase: explain the basic idea behind X; tell me about the function of X; give an overview of X; describe the principle behind X. Do not apply the compact treatment signal.

contamination_gates.identity: canonical URL: lowercase scheme/host, remove fragment, preserve query, empty path becomes /
contamination_gates.action: reject deterministically; never relabel or alter frozen query text

stopping_rule: Capture in frozen capture_order until exactly 474 valid results per arm; no interim inferential analysis and no stopping on relevance, p-value, lift, broad relevance, or arm behavior.

missing_failed_requests.HTTP failure: record failed attempt; retry same query once, then reject
missing_failed_requests.provider timeout: record; retry same query once, then reject
missing_failed_requests.duplicate-heavy query: record accepted/rejected rows; proceed in order
missing_failed_requests.contamination-heavy query: reject contaminated rows; proceed in order
missing_failed_requests.replacement: only next unused query from frozen universe in capture_order; no manual substitution

labeling.arm_blinding: blind arm designation and all arm metrics; expose only query/result fields needed for labeling

primary_analysis.comparison: Treatment Relevant proportion vs Control Relevant proportion
primary_analysis.test: one-sided Fisher exact test at alpha=.05; report exact two-sided sensitivity p-value separately if desired
primary_analysis.multiple_testing: none for the single primary endpoint; additional analyses are secondary/exploratory

decision_rule.success: VALIDATE_ACQUISITION_STRATEGY only if strict Treatment yield > strict Control yield, absolute improvement >= 0.05, one-sided Fisher p <= 0.05, and all integrity gates pass.
decision_rule.failure: REJECT_ACQUISITION_STRATEGY if integrity passes and the primary endpoint is directionally non-superior or evidence is incompatible with alpha, including failure of the useful-effect threshold.
decision_rule.inconclusive: INCONCLUSIVE if integrity is compromised, valid target is not reached under the frozen universe/budget, or the primary test cannot be validly computed.

request_budget.retry_policy: at most one retry for HTTP failure or timeout; same query only
request_budget.planning_basis: one initial request per frozen query plus one bounded retry; V3 acceptance rates are planning reference only, not guarantee
